data: First soft landing on another planet and first to transmit data from another planet's surface (Venus, 1970)
Skeleton entry for /fleet (PRD-012 v0.2 / Phase A scaffold). Builder + agency + first-flight per public sources. Specs and gallery TBD in later phases.

Venera 7-class is a planetary lander built by NPO Lavochkin in USSR. First soft landing on another planet and first to transmit data from another planet's surface (Venus, 1970). Mission ended in 1970.
First human-made object to reach Mars surface; lander crashed (1971)
First soft landing on Mars; 14.5 s of surface transmission
Soviet 1973 Mars lander — first descent telemetry from Mars atmosphere (224 s, mostly corrupted)
First soft landing on another world
Last successful Soviet Moon mission — returned 170 g of Mare Crisium regolith 1976-08-22; last lunar sample return until Chang'e 5
